# Kamunity Consulting — llms.txt
> Mike Fuller's consulting practice for the WA community and nonprofit sector.

## What Is This Site?
kamunityconsulting.com is the consulting website for Mike Fuller, built by Kamunity. Static HTML site using the Kamunity campfire design system (parchment, ember red, deep sky blue, Georgia serif).

## Services — Two Doors

### Fix the shit things (red door)
QA, process improvement, system design, team turnarounds, strategy. Starting point: the thing you already know is broken.
Proof: RAC — $500k found in 9 months, nobody fired.

### Do the impossible thing (blue door)
Innovation sprints, AI integration, human-centred design, hackathons, community innovation.
Proof: WA Health Hackathon — won by talking to humans first.

## Who It's For
WA community organisations, nonprofits, disability services, social services — any team where the problem is visible but the path isn't.

## About Mike Fuller
30 years of quality, improvement and innovation across brewing, mining, disability, and community services. Glasgow to Perth. Holy trinity: QA → Improvement → Innovation. Anti-McKinsey. Post-modern structuralist.

## Kai (AI on this site)
An embedded version of Kai lives on every page as a floating chat button. Session-only — nothing stored. Constitutionally-governed. Full Kai at kamunity.org.

## Tech
Static HTML + CSS + Vanilla JS. No build step. Netlify deployment. Kai via Netlify Function proxy to Anthropic Claude API (server-side key only).
